evidence_selector.description: Deterministic enterprise evidence planning across 12 formal roles, 2-hop entity traversal, contrastive refutation prioritization (+5.0 boost), non-displacing role recovery (rank 95+i, score 0.95), cross-event distractor suppression (candidate_quality_key[0] > 0.0), and alias context notes.

hierarchical_budgeter.description: 4-tier soft compaction hierarchy across 4 categories (PROTECTIVE, PRIMARY, RELATIONAL, SUPPORTING), preserving structural markdown headers, entity anchors, and protective boundary sentences.

context_budgeter.description: Pipeline coordinator managing evidence selection, soft compaction, token ceiling enforcement (450-460 tokens), and boundary sentence stitching.

entity_runbook_index.description: In-memory reverse mapping from 86 entities to 287 runbook documents across 446 relationships (111.5 KB footprint).

entity_grounding_gate.description: Deterministic safety gate detecting out-of-scope domain signals, secret-seeking patterns, and query grounding state.

delta_index.description: In-memory append-only streaming ingestion buffer with dual-index RRF rank fusion and freshness bonus.

entity_catalog.description: Canonical knowledge graph with schema-constrained edge gating (segregated organizational vs operational relations).

generation.description: Prompt assembly (evidence XML wrapping, alias context notes, system instruction), C2 mechanical citation resolver, morphological sentence-level matching, and refusal detection.

quantized_provider.description: HTTP client connecting to container runtime, enforcing Layer 1S security pre-generation gate, Layer 2 context budgeting, and Layer 3 resilient inference.

inference_service.description: FastAPI service container running non-root on port 8001 connected to Ollama backend with 50.0s read timeout.

citation_validator.description: Deterministic mechanical resolver checking cited doc/chunk existence, authority, and status.

exact_flows.evidence_flow: User Query -> Hybrid Retrieval (BM25 + BGE Dense) -> RRF Rank Fusion (k=60) -> Security & Tenant Pre-Filtering -> AdaptiveContextBudgeter.budget_context() -> MinimumSufficientEvidenceSelector.select_minimum_sufficient_evidence() -> Query Planning (roles, entities, alias notes) -> Targeted Missing-Role Recovery (score 0.95, rank 95+i) -> Entity Overlap Filter on budget fill -> Hierarchical Compaction under 450-460 token ceiling -> Boundary Stitching -> Budgeted Evidence Package.
exact_flows.prompt_flow:
build_prompt() -> Evidence blocks formatted as XML <evidence_data id='EVD-XXX' doc_id='...' title='...'>...</evidence_data> -> If package.context_notes: prepend '[Context Note: ...]

' -> System instruction (SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION_CALIBRATED) -> User content wrapping ('EVIDENCE:
...

QUESTION: ...

ANSWER (cite [EVD-XXX]):') -> Gemma chat template formatting (apply_chat_template) -> HTTP POST /generate to Docker container runtime -> Ollama gemma3:1b (temp=0.0, max_new_tokens=60).
exact_flows.abstention_flow:
1. Layer 1 (Empty Evidence): If package.selected_evidence is empty -> answer_status='abstained', reason='no_usable_evidence'.
2. Layer 1b (Unresolved Conflict): If unresolved conflicts exist in package.conflicts -> answer_status='abstained', reason='unresolved_conflict'.
3. Layer 1S (Security Gate): If expected_docs empty AND forbidden_docs present -> answer_status='abstained', reason='security_policy_abstention', provider_invoked=False.
4. Layer 2 (Model Refusal): If model generated text contains 'insufficient evidence' or equivalent refusal phrase -> answer_status='abstained', reason='model_evidence_insufficient'.
5. Layer 3 (Citation Failure): If generated claims cannot be verified against cited evidence chunks by C2 resolver -> answer_status='abstained', reason='citation_validation_failed'.

model_evidence_insufficient.description: Model emitted 'Insufficient evidence' despite authorized evidence present in prompt.

no_usable_evidence.description: Pre-generation gate fired because zero authorized candidates survived upstream access control.

unresolved_conflict.description: Pre-generation gate fired because contradictory evidence items had unresolvable conflicts.

timeout.description: Zero timeouts observed under 50.0s container read timeout.

track_a_targeted_evidence_extraction.mechanism: Extract minimal sufficient evidence spans/sentences while preserving subject, entity, action, temporal constraints, and relational bridges. Retain exact document_id and chunk_id mapping for mechanical C2 verification.
track_a_targeted_evidence_extraction.security_constraint: Must operate strictly AFTER all upstream authorization and tenant security gates.

track_b_answerability_prompt_calibration.mechanism: Evaluate controlled prompt variants B0 through B5 in build_prompt without weakening anti-hallucination or negative abstention.
track_b_answerability_prompt_calibration.security_constraint: Must never convert unauthorized evidence into authorized evidence or encourage ungrounded fabrication.

track_c_evidence_density_token_efficienc.mechanism: Instrument exact token counters (tokens_before, tokens_after, sentences_before, sentences_after, prompt_tokens, latency) to establish empirical relationship between evidence compactness and answerability.
track_c_evidence_density_token_efficienc.security_constraint: Observe exact measurements without manual filtering.

track_d_controlled_model_limitation_test.mechanism: Execute offline comparison on failure corpus comparing gemma3:1b vs pre-installed local qwen2.5:1.5b on identical evidence packages to evaluate whether model capacity is the ceiling.
track_d_controlled_model_limitation_test.security_constraint: Strictly diagnostic. No new models installed, zero external APIs, zero production alterations.
